criteria.description: [R1] `from app_int.main import cube` succeeds and `cube` is callable.
[R2] `inspect.signature(app_int.main.cube)` has exactly one parameter, and that parameter is named `n`.
[R3, R4] `cube(3) == 27`, `cube(1) == 1` and `cube(10) == 1000`, and each result is an instance of `int`.
[R7] `health_check() == {"status": "ok"}` and `add(2, 3) == 5` still hold, and the existing tests in `tests/test_main.py` pass unchanged.
[R8] `app_int.main.cube.__annotations__` contains an entry for `n` and an entry for `return`, both `int`.
[R10] At least one test function under `tests/` imports `cube` from `app_int.main` and asserts on its return value.
[R11] `uv run pytest -q` exits with status 0 and its output shows at least one test covering `cube`.
[R11] `uv run ruff check .` exits with status 0.
